label: Consultant site: make the testimonials specific and drop the empty one
instruction: These testimonials are generic and one of them says nothing at all. Make the two real ones specific about the result, drop the empty one, and calm the styling down.

response.summary: Rewrote both testimonials around measurable results, removed the empty third, and calmed the card styling.

actions.reason: Two ruled cards with no shadow suit a consulting practice better than three rounded ones.

changes.quote: Priya spent two weeks measuring before she recommended anything, and then changed three things. Our despatch queue halved and we cancelled the two roles we were about to hire.
changes.name: Aisha Kelleher

actions.reason: Names the method and the measurable result, which is what a prospective client is looking for.

changes.quote: The value was in what she told us not to do. We arrived expecting a restructure and left with three process changes and a much shorter list of problems.
changes.name: Ben Osei

actions.reason: A second, differently shaped endorsement so the two do not read as the same review twice.
The third card carries no attributable quote and no role, so it weakens the other two.
